site.name: Euler Borges Ferreira Filho
site.summary: Computer Engineer graduated from UFU, with practical experience in developing and maintaining APIs using Python and Django. Solid knowledge in relational databases, containerization, and AWS infrastructure (AWS Academy Cloud Architecting certified). Fluent in English.

details: Participation in undergraduate research projects aimed at studying chaotic dynamics using Python programs.
Development in Rust programming language with a focus on distributed systems.
Completed academic coursework in Machine Learning, covering foundational concepts, predictive models, and data analysis.

bullets: Development and maintenance of approximately 100 API endpoints using Python and Django Framework.
Bug fixing in pre-existing features of the applications.
Active role in delegating technical tasks to the backend team and participation in tech recruitment selection processes.
Creation of automated tests using pytest.

items.title: AWS Infrastructure with Terraform
items.description: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) on AWS built with Terraform. Resilient and scalable architecture using ECS Fargate (Django/Nginx), RDS PostgreSQL, S3 buckets, and a structured VPC with private endpoints for security and cost optimization.

items.title: Django Social Network Backend
items.description: Development of a backend for a social network using Django Framework. Implementation of features such as authentication, user management, post creation and interaction, as well as integration with relational databases and automated testing.
